summary: Fresh independent protocol review found no BLOCKER, REQUIRED_FOLLOWUP or NONBLOCKING findings. HG034 authorizes only the exact future planning fixture namespace adaptation and retains all residual ledger semantics. This governance review does not establish KL025 task, product requirement, release or merge PASS.
verified_observations: Resolved authority through CURRENT_DOCUMENT_INDEX.json and read the KL025 packet, governance/review/merge contracts, repository protocol-guardian and pr-merge-reviewer skills, exact protected-base diff, frozen Protocol sections 2, 6.1-6.7 and T5/T8, DB S27-S32, command ownership, frozen lock order, T5/T8, INV10/11/12/13/16/17, idempotent dispatch and deny-by-default release boundaries. The changed production, migration, frozen, CI, requirement and completed-prerequisite path sets are empty.

Independently compared every protected-base KL025 check oracle to the reviewed revision: all existing oracles are identical; only the planning regression command gains the exact selector and one isolation proof is added. Hard dependency remains KL024, status remains NOT_STARTED, requirements_covered remains empty and the protected-base/head review union remains GENERAL/PROTOCOL/DB_CONCURRENCY. Root-budget arithmetic across attempts/revisions, strict current request/attempt/owner/fence/deadline checks, exact S27/S31/S32 and S02/S03/S04 atomicity, cancellation/dispatch exclusion, non-sendable replay, UNKNOWN occupation, accounting-only reliable late settlement and network-outside-coordination requirements remain unchanged.

Inspected actual merged workflow/planning.py, persistence/planning.py, transactions.py and planning_intents.md. Typed admission/acquire/renew API fields match the preflight; root payload contains limits/reserved/settled and retained admission identity. Join/revision preserves original deadline and root payload; locked current-fence SQL binds subject/current request/current attempt/owner/token and strict trusted-time lease/deadline. Existing dispatch owner permits only the first RESERVED-to-DISPATCH_INTENT winner, historical replay reports sendable=false, and expected_transition UNKNOWN maps to OUTCOME_UNKNOWN. The prospective ledger task must add bounded accounting restrictions and CancelUndispatched through existing owners, without generic mutation authority or regained T6 authority.

Inspected all called fixture surfaces: planning and transaction unit files have no database lifecycle; planning database_urls supplies its selected lifecycle to migration bootstrap; transaction database_urls supplies the existing KL022 override namespace to bootstrap, safety seed and transaction seed. Subsequent truncation/reseeding uses the yielded admin URL; role URLs come from that same reset database; finally destroys that same lifecycle. DatabaseLifecycle.environment overwrites generic project/database injection, supporting the specific fixture adaptation rather than a silent override. No additional called-fixture mismatch was found.

Applied the committed zero-context planning_namespace.patch to a disposable clone at the exact reviewed SHA. Its resulting complete file equals ledger_planning_fixture_candidate of protected-base bytes. Independently compared ASTs: all six planning test functions and every other existing helper are unchanged; only database_urls receives namespace selection and the new helper is added. The scope guard compares complete bytes and rejects assertion, policy, bootstrap, cleanup, import, selector and unrelated edits; it creates no test skip, migration repair, product bypass or mixed-governance exception.

Independently reran the selector probe on that exact applied candidate without database calls: unset preserves KL024 names; exact KL-025 uses validated 7-12 lowercase-hex SHA plus resolved-worktree digest; same SHA in different worktrees differs. Eight invalid selectors and eight invalid SHA values fail before runner/bootstrap/teardown. Valid bootstrap and cleanup receive the same selected namespace. Independently reran merged audit and all four focused scope files at reviewed HEAD: audit PASS and 98 tests PASS.

Read selected revision-bound raw evidence and scripts. The tested SHA candidate uses unchanged actual merged KL024 product/fixture bytes plus only the prospective patch; runtime tracing confines reset/destroy to the two selected KL025 planning/regression namespaces. All 66 called planning/transaction regressions and 25 candidate scope checks pass. Selected governance checks bind tested_commit with exit 0: focused 98, harness 265, unit 204, lint/typecheck and HARNESS_CHECK_PASS. Earlier diagnostic evidence remains unselected. These candidate runs are explicitly CANDIDATE_ISOLATION_PROOF_ONLY, and all 16 future KL025 checks remain obligations rather than task PASS.

Verified Git records protected base as the normal PR62 merge, required KL024 PASS reviews bind one exact reviewed implementation/result SHA, the premerge suffix is review-record-only, and the completed KL024 result is byte-identical. Its historical UNMERGED field and absent integration artifact are explicitly disclosed and not rewritten. The tested-to-reviewed suffix changes only the governance record and new evidence; reviewed implementation/packet/validator bytes match tested_commit. Production auto-activation, non-executable real-data shadow, isolated TEST subjects/policies, provider-evidence-only trust, planned-versus-actual separation and product/release statuses remain unchanged. Only HG034 review-directory appends may follow without rereview.
limitations: No independent PostgreSQL rerun was performed for this specialist review; the committed real PostgreSQL candidate proof was inspected, and independent local verification covered merged preflight, exact patch/semantic preservation, selector safety and scope regressions.

This review approves HG034 governance at the exact reviewed SHA. KL025 implementation, all required task checks, downstream WF/E2E evidence, product requirements, release acceptance and production activation remain unestablished.
